intro: This quest is the critical step in shutting down the Venture Company machinery at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens. Having already shut down the surrounding valves, an operative must secure the console key from Tinkerer Sniggles to open the main control unit and extract the mysterious samophlange.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
